title: rubus sachalinensis var. coreanus
intro: Rubus sachalinensis var. coreanus, commonly known as the Amur black raspberry, is a type of bramble plant native to East Asia. It is valued for its edible fruits, which are rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rubus sachalinensis var. coreanus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
